summary: Cannon County, TN steel fire tower under construction in 1961 and listed as standing in 2014; no owner, staffing or access arrangement found.

events.note: Under construction in 1961 per a Cannon County history caption; a steel tower was finished by the end of that year per the lookout directory
Listed among extant Tennessee fire towers as of March 26, 2014

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1961 caption shows the tower under construction; the lookout directory says a steel tower was finished by year end. Both place the work in 1961.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975 (National Register multiple property documentation form)

notes_for_editor: The 1961 date rests on two independent short entries that agree. No agency, owner, staffing or access arrangement found after one search. The 2014 list and the undated Landforms entry are the only evidence of condition. Caption credits US Soil Conservation Service in parentheses; photo rights not checked, so no photo added.
